GO Battle League: Twilight Trails Update

Trainers,

GO Battle League: Twilight Trails is almost here!

GO Battle League: Twilight Trails

GO Battle League: Twilight Trails will start on Tuesday, September 8, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. PDT (GMT −7).

The following will occur at the beginning of the Season.

  • End-of-Season rewards will be available on the Battle screen.
  • Your GO Battle League rank will be reset.

Mega Evolution is expanding in the GO Battle League!

Following the sudden appearance of Mega Chesnaught, Mega Delphox, and Mega Greninja in San Francisco, Mega-Evolved Pokémon are joining the battle in the GO Battle League! This change will start with Pokémon GO: Twilight Trails and continue in future Seasons.

Beginning with Pokémon GO Fest: Mega Finale, certain eligible Mega-Evolved Pokémon will have access to an additional Charged Attack no matter what Mega Level they are, bringing exciting new strategies to the GO Battle League. Learn more about additional Charged Attacks and featured Mega-Evolved Pokémon during the Mega Finale here.

Also, for the first time in the Pokémon GO Championship Series, Mega-Evolved Pokémon will be eligible during the 2026 Pokémon Latin America International Championships!

In the near future, the CP of Mega-Evolved Pokémon will automatically be reduced temporarily so that they can participate in the Great League: Mega Edition and Ultra League: Mega Edition. CP will only be reduced for the duration of the battle and will return to the original CP after completion of the battle.

Twilight Trails GO Battle League Events

Daily Discoveries: GO Battle Thursday

Thursdays between 12:00 a.m. and 11:59 p.m. local time

Continuing with Twilight Trails, different days of the week will have a Daily Discovery experience associated with it each week.

  • Up to 4× Stardust from win rewards. (This does not include end-of-set rewards.)
  • The maximum number of sets you can play per day will increase from five to 10—for a total of 50 battles.

GO Battle League Timed Research Pass

For our most dedicated battlers, a pass to access battle-themed Timed Research will be available in the in-game shop at no cost once GO Battle League: Twilight Trails begins.

This Timed Research will keep track of your victories throughout the Season. The first research page will require catching Pokémon and will award encounters with Pokémon that will help Trainers build their GO Battle League team. Each subsequent research page will require 100 battles and 50 wins to complete, and doing so will award Stardust and items such as Rare Candy XL, an Elite Fast TM, and an Elite Charged TM. Keep at it throughout the Season to see how far you can get!

Avatar Items and Other Rewards

Trainers will be able to earn the following avatar items, which are all inspired by Ryme, the Gym Leader of Montenevera Gym in the Paldea region.

  • At Rank 10, you’ll receive shoes inspired by Ryme.
  • At Rank 15, you’ll receive a cap and earrings inspired by Ryme.
  • At Rank 20, you’ll receive an outfit inspired by Ryme.
  • At Legend rank, you’ll receive a pose inspired by Ryme.

Cups

You can look forward to the following cups this Season.

Great League: Mega Edition

  • Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter.
  • Mega-Evolved Pokémon are eligible.

Ultra League: Mega Edition

  • Pokémon must be at or below 2,500 CP to enter.
  • Mega-Evolved Pokémon are eligible.

Master League: Mega Edition

  • Mega-Evolved Pokémon are eligible.

Willpower Cup: Great League Edition

  • Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter.
  • Only Fighting-, Psychic-, and Dark-type Pokémon are eligible.

The following Pokémon are not allowed.

Gardevoir
Zorua
Zoroark

Retro Cup: Great League Edition

  • Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter.
  • Dark-, Steel-, and Fairy-type Pokémon are not eligible.

Mega Color Cup: Great League Edition

  • Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter.
  • Mega-Evolved Pokémon are eligible.
  • Only Grass-, Fire-, Water-, Electric-type Pokémon are eligible.

Little Cup

  • Pokémon must be at or below 500 CP to enter.
  • Only Pokémon that are able to evolve and have not evolved even once are eligible.

Fantasy Cup: Great League Edition

  • Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter.
  • Only Dragon-, Steel-, and Fairy-type Pokémon are eligible.

Mega Halloween Cup: Great League Edition

  • Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter.
  • Mega-Evolved Pokémon are eligible.
  • Only Bug-, Poison-, Ghost-, Dark-, and Fairy-type Pokémon are eligible.

2026 GO LAIC Cup

  • Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter.
  • Fire-, Dark-, Steel-, and Fairy-type Pokémon are not eligible.
  • Legendary Pokémon, Mythical Pokémon, and Ultra Beasts are not eligible.
  • Mega-Evolved Pokémon are not eligible for the GO Battle League version of this Cup. However, Mega-Evolved Pokémon will be eligible for the Pokémon Latin America International Championships 2026 in-person competition.

The following Pokémon are not allowed.

Chansey
Snorlax
Furret
Wobbuffet
Galarian Corsola
Kingdra
Medicham
Altaria
Dusclops
Jellicent
Jellicent
Araquanid
Oranguru
Annihilape
Clodsire

Mega Catch Cup: Great League Edition

  • Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter.
  • Mega-Evolved Pokémon are eligible.
  • Only Pokémon caught during the Twilight Trails Season are eligible.*
  • Mythical Pokémon are not eligible.
*Pokémon must be caught between September 8, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. and December 1, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. PST.

Attack Changes

Air Cutter

  • Trainer Battles: 45 → 60 power and decreased chance to increase user’s Attack by one stage.
  • Energy cost increased

  • Trainer Battles: 45 → 80 power and guaranteed chance to decrease the opponent’s Defense by one stage.
  • Energy cost increased
